content.text:
Nobody has published a direct benchmark comparison of the two, so there are no numbers to put side by side.

**What the sources say:**
1. **K2.8 Preview:** Moonshot has released no benchmark scores for it. Its only claim is that K2.8 "approaches K3," which is Moonshot's own judgment and hasn't been tested independently. LLM Stats found no benchmark that both models were scored on.
2. **K3:** This is the flagship model, with 2.8 trillion parameters. Moonshot's launch scores, as reported by other sites, include GPQA 93.5, BrowseComp 91.2 and Terminal-Bench 2.1 88.3. That Terminal-Bench score is close to GPT-5.6 Sol (88.8) and reportedly ahead of Claude Opus 4.8. Artificial Analysis reportedly gives K3 59.7 on its Intelligence index and 76.2 on its Coding index.
3. **Shared specs:** Both models accept about 1M tokens of input. K3 has a published price; K2.8 doesn't have one yet.

**Caveat:** Most of these figures come from aggregator sites with dates that don't line up. K3's BrowseComp score also changes with setup: 91.2 when the context is compacted, 90.4 with the full 1M window. Check them against Moonshot's official release notes before relying on them.

**How to choose:** Use K3 if you need numbers you can actually compare. Pick K2.8 only if it turns out cheaper or faster for your workload, and test it yourself, since there's no published data on it.

**Next step (~2 min):** open the [llm-stats comparison](https://llm-stats.com/models/compare/kimi-k2.8-vs-kimi-k3) and check whether K2.8 scores have been added.
